panels.description: INTERIOR, GRANDMOTHER'S APARTMENT. Grandmother folds a cloth while Pilar checks a paper dose grid. Keep the upper room clear.
Grandmother looks toward Alex and briefly mistakes him for Adrian. Keep the upper room clear.
Grandmother offers Alex Adrian's hand-bound notebook. Keep the upper notebook area clear.
Ada sets food beside Grandmother's chair while Alex studies pump sketches and water-drop marks. Keep the upper wall clear.

items.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
items.text: He said you’d know when you were ready.
